text: Katrina Lehis (born 19 December 1994) is an Estonian left-handed épée fencer who won the 2018 individual European championship, became a 2021 team Olympic champion, and earned a bronze medal in individual épée at the 2021 Olympics. She began fencing in 2004 and was coached by Helen Nelis-Naukas and Peeter Nelis. Since 2009, she has been a member of the Estonian Junior and Cadet fencing teams. In 2014, she won individual gold at the Junior World Fencing Championships and was awarded Estonian Young Athlete of the Year. She secured team épée silver medals at the 2015 European Fencing Championships and the 2015 European Games. In 2018, she won individual gold at the European Fencing Championships. At the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, she won a gold medal in team épée and a bronze in individual épée. In 2017, Lehis gave birth to a son.
